title: Haze: Vampiric Burst vs Leech at 41.6k (fire rate + ammo refill vs constant healing)
question: Kieran's open question: Leech (28% bullet+spirit lifesteal, +12% weapon, anti-heal reduction) or Vampiric Burst (13% + 70% active for 5 s, +34% fire rate, refills 75% ammo)?
hypothesis: Model: VB +752 damage and +2736 HP vs Leech +87 / +646 in a 12 s focus fight at 41.6k, mainly from the ammo refill on a 55-round magazine that empties in ~4 s. Prediction: VB arm deals >=15% more damage in a 12 s scripted fight and heals more.

arms.name: vampiric_burst
arms.notes: VB is first active (i1); pop it when the first magazine is empty

controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
same scripted 12 s timeline in both arms: cast 2 0.3; fire 4; [VB: cast i1 0.3 | Leech: cast reload 2.35]; fire 4; cast reload 2.35; fire 1.3
procedure: give arm items; lowhp 50; cast reload 2.5; mark <arm>; run the 12 s timeline; healsum; lowhp 0; hardreset

decision.rule: SUPPORTS VB core if VB damage >=10% higher and heal not lower (non-overlapping ranges); REFUTES if Leech wins both; else INCONCLUSIVE. The anti-heal condition of the Leech swap is UNSUPPORTED (no eheal op, GAPS #8) and is decided from kit maths.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
